prompt: Create an original 180 second fingerstyle acoustic folk instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: steel-string guitar, mandolin, light hand percussion. Style: alternating bass picking and a clear acoustic melody. Tempo approximately 82 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A gentle and reflective acoustic instrumental track featuring fingerpicked guitar, subtle bass, and light percussion. The melody is calm and flowing.
description.zh: 一首温柔而富有沉思感的原声器乐曲，以指弹吉他、细腻的贝斯和轻柔的打击乐为主，旋律平静流畅。
